# lantronix-slcxx-o2_port (Resource)

Serial settings of one SLC Device Port. Creating a resource adopts the existing port; destroying it only forgets it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number` (Number) Device Port number (1-48 on an SLC48; the device validates the upper bound).

### Optional

- `baud_rate` (Number) One of 300/600/1200/2400/4800/9600/19200/38400/57600/115200.
- `data_bits` (Number) 7 or 8.
- `flow_control` (String) none, xon/xoff, or rts/cts.
- `logins` (Boolean) Serial-side SLC login prompt; must be false for network-endpoint use.
- `name` (String) Port label as shown by `show deviceport names`.
- `parity` (String) none, odd, or even.
- `stop_bits` (Number) 1 or 2.
